Messages.Author: Else Bruset Solberg
Messages.Body:
Which of the following statements are true?

The cards that are in my hand are secret, but I may at any time tell the
other players what cards i have in hand (even if i lie).

The cards that are in my hand are secret, but I may hint what I have (if I'm
beeing bled by my grand-predator and have deflection, i may sey "it's
possible the bleed wont end up targeting me").

The cards that are in my hand are secret, I may in no way tell or hint what
cards I got.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Else Bruset Solberg wrote:
>
> Which of the following statements are true?

... baring explicit card text to the contrary (Revelations, for example):

> The cards that are in my hand are secret, but I may at any time tell the
> other players what cards i have in hand (even if i lie).

True.

> The cards that are in my hand are secret, but I may hint what I have (if I'm
> beeing bled by my grand-predator and have deflection, i may sey "it's
> possible the bleed wont end up targeting me").

True.

> The cards that are in my hand are secret, I may in no way tell or hint what
> cards I got.

False.
